messages:
Maya Nguyen: Quick sync — onboarding MARLIN-2.0 (open model) into the catalog. Two asks: (1) licensing check — looks like CC-BY-NC in the repo, need legal signoff and product flagging. (2) embeddings shape: model outputs 1536-d but our embeddings consumers expect 1024-d. Plan: adapter or migration? Also perf note: baseline tokens/sec ~30% slower than mariner profile on A100. Planning a small perf sweep + canary for Mon 03/30. @Samir Patel @Jordan Lee @Olivia Chen @LegalBot :wave:
Samir Patel: I can take licensing. I scanned LICENSE.md — it says CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). For hosted offering we need to mark 'restricted' and get legal confirmation. @LegalBot PTAL.
LegalBot: Noted. Review queued as ticket LR-981. ETA ~2 business days. If NC-only we must surface the restriction in product listing and block commercial sale until cleared.
Jordan Lee: On embeddings — we have a lightweight adapter (linear projection or PCA) in ml-serving that can map 1536 -> 1024. Risk: small quality drop. I can add an eval harness to compare. Need a CR + dataset to run.
Olivia Chen: I can run perf sweep. Which model variants should I test and what sequence-length mix? FP16 and q4_0 ok?
Maya Nguyen: Yes — test marlin-2.0-fp16 and marlin-2.0-q4_0. Use our standard seq mix: 70% short (<=64), 25% mid (<=512), 5% long (<=2048). Post summary to this thread and upload raw logs.
DeployBot: Canary created: marlin-2.0-fp16 -> canary-2026-03-24-07 (us-west1), traffic 1%.
Luis García: FYI routing: if we mark as 'restricted' we must add an exception so auto-routing won't send it to dedicated customers flagged for GA. I'll draft a guardrail PR for the routing policy.
Rachel T: I'll prepare the product doc blurb and a short migration guide for embeddings once legal confirms the license.
Samir Patel: Legal note — if it stays NC-only we cannot offer it on paid Dedicated capacity without written permission. Flagging for sales + support handoff.
Jordan Lee: CR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/482 — adapter code + eval harness (still draft). Please leave review comments. I'll queue the eval job once CI artifacts land.
Maya Nguyen: Action items: Samir -> follow LR-981; Jordan -> finish PR #482; Olivia -> perf sweep and post numbers; Luis -> routing guardrail PR; Rachel -> docs draft. Target canary Mon 03/30 but we'll hold full catalog launch until legal OK. :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: Perf sweep quick results: marlin-2.0-fp16 median latency 45ms @256 tokens, marlin-2.0-q4_0 median 52ms @256 tokens. Throughput q4_0 ~0.9x fp16. Uploading raw logs to https://artifacts.redwood-inference/ci/marlin-2.0/perf-2026-03-24.tar.gz — detailed summary in #model-metrics.
LegalBot: Review complete. License is CC-BY-NC — recommend marking model as 'restricted-noncommercial' and allowing catalog listing only with that flag. Legal approves adding to catalog with that restriction.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks all. I'll update the intake form, tag the model 'restricted-noncommercial', block Dedicated sale in product config, and proceed with the planned canary. Closing loop — please archive any follow-ups in PR #482 and LR-981. :white_check_mark:
